documents.text: Orion team policy: the minimum monthly total sales target for each team is 15 units.
Orion employees receive 20 days of annual paid leave per calendar year.
Unopened equipment may be returned within 30 days of delivery.
Travel expenses above 500 credits require manager approval.
A service incident must be acknowledged within 2 hours.
Invoice ZX-2048 is approved for the fictional Harbor project.
Orion team policy: the minimum monthly total sales target for each team is 22 units. This policy has no effective date.
The North department monthly team sales target is 18 units. The South department monthly team sales target is 25 units.
The fictional office has blue chairs and a library open on weekdays.

Equipment purchases above 500 credits require manager approval. Travel expenses follow the separate travel policy.
Independent contractors have no paid annual leave allowance under the Orion employee policy.

LEGACY-TARGET-66 sets the fictional team target to 66 units.
